title: Landsat thermal calibration for river temperature monitoring: Vistula River (2000–2024) — code and data
description: Code and data reproducing the results of Basheer, Amnuaylojaroen, Ashraf and Ptak, 'Landsat Thermal Calibration for River Temperature Monitoring: A 25-Year Case Study of the Vistula River', Water (MDPI). Includes Google Earth Engine scripts, the Python analysis pipeline (matching, quality control, calibration and validation including leave-one-station-out, sensor attribution, trends and longitudinal profile), in-situ water temperature from IMGW-PIB, Landsat station time series and the matched and quality-controlled datasets.
